limits: JS heap is browser-provided, potentially quantized; not total process or GPU memory.
Graphics estimates include hidden scene assets, omit driver/framebuffer overhead and are not additive with heap.
DOM images exclude browser-owned decoded caches and off-DOM images.
Per-model numbers are load-time inventories; scene inventory deduplicates shared resources.
Two-second samples may miss brief peaks; long-task and resource observers supplement them.
No forced GC or disposal; profiling does not change loading policy.
